name: smwmusic-thunder-force-iv-metal-squad
title: Thunder Force IV - Metal Squad
description:
Metal Squad from TFIV, the track everyone loves to say could never be done on a SNES, is now done on the SNES and here for you to use in SMW hacks!!!!!!!!!!! Cool!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Anyway, with how rocking this track is, it's best suited for more intense kinds of levels, like a castle, lava, athletic, and maybe even a abstract/space stage if you're able to include some kinda shmup level thing somehow, I dunno; obviously though, where you use this is up to you really, so yeah, don't take this as a end-all-be-all or anything lmao

(oh yeah, and boss fights too I guess.)
